title: Find Median in a Large Unsorted Array
prompt:
Implement find_median(nums) -> float for one large, unsorted list of integers. Return the middle value after ordering the values when len(nums) is odd; when it is even, return the arithmetic mean of the two middle values. Always return a float.

nums contains between 1 and 100000 integers, each in the inclusive 32-bit signed range. This is a static-array selection problem, not a streaming-median API. Meet an expected O(N) time target for one call: randomized Quickselect is a suitable approach, while sorting the whole array is O(N log N) and does not meet the target. You may rearrange nums in place.

example.reasoning: The sorted values are [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], so the middle value is 3.
